fullText.simplified:
没有做完的事

    终于，天快黑的时候，路那边，一队人跑了过来，最前面的那个人拿着大刀，穿着红衣，就是太史慈。孙策身边的人大声说：“是太史慈！”大家都很高兴，都说“太史慈回来了”。
    孙策没有说话，但是也高兴地笑了。
    从那一天开始，太史慈就是孙策的人了。他跟着孙策回了江东，后来一直在江东工作。他和孙策做了好朋友，还帮了孙策很多忙。他看孙策越来越厉害，也看到江东越来越好。后来的他和孙策一样，都是江东非常重要的人。
    孙策回到了江东的家。
    离开元树的时候，孙策只有三千人。回到家的时候，孙策已经有三万人了。他带着这三万人，在江东又打了五年。这五年里，那些想做江东主人的人，那些让江东不安静的人，都被孙策打败了。江东慢慢变安静了，再也没有军队打来打去。现在，江东只有一个主人，那就是孙策。
    二十六岁的孙策，把他的名字写进了每个江东人的心里。
    江东慢慢变好了，每个人都很高兴。孙策看到大家高兴，他也高兴。但是有时候，想到一些事和人，他还是会难过。他知道，他还有很多事没有做，这些事都是爸爸没有做完的。
    让他难过的事是荆州，让他难过的人是刘表。他不会忘记，爸爸死在荆州，杀他的人是刘表。孙策刚回来的那几年，荆州很安静，刘表没有打到江东来。现在，刘表老了。他是一个老人了，不想打仗了。但是，孙策想打荆州，他一直在准备。
    孙策想等江东好一些了，就去打荆州。他每天都努力工作，在等一个打荆州的机会。
fullText.traditional:
沒有做完的事

    終於，天快黑的時候，路那邊，一隊人跑了過來，最前面的那個人拿著大刀，穿著紅衣，就是太史慈。孫策身邊的人大聲說：“是太史慈！”大家都很高興，都說“太史慈回來了”。
    孫策沒有說話，但是也高興地笑了。
    從那一天開始，太史慈就是孫策的人了。他跟著孫策回了江東，後來一直在江東工作。他和孫策做了好朋友，還幫了孫策很多忙。他看孫策越來越厲害，也看到江東越來越好。後來的他和孫策一樣，都是江東非常重要的人。
    孫策回到了江東的家。
    離開元樹的時候，孫策只有三千人。回到家的時候，孫策已經有三萬人了。他帶著這三萬人，在江東又打了五年。這五年裡，那些想做江東主人的人，那些讓江東不安靜的人，都被孫策打敗了。江東慢慢變安靜了，再也沒有軍隊打來打去。現在，江東只有一個主人，那就是孫策。
    二十六歲的孫策，把他的名字寫進了每個江東人的心裡。
    江東慢慢變好了，每個人都很高興。孫策看到大家高興，他也高興。但是有時候，想到一些事和人，他還是會難過。他知道，他還有很多事沒有做，這些事都是爸爸沒有做完的。
    讓他難過的事是荊州，讓他難過的人是劉表。他不會忘記，爸爸死在荊州，殺他的人是劉表。孫策剛回來的那幾年，荊州很安靜，劉表沒有打到江東來。現在，劉表老了。他是一個老人了，不想打仗了。但是，孫策想打荊州，他一直在準備。
    孫策想等江東好一些了，就去打荊州。他每天都努力工作，在等一個打荊州的機會。

sentences.simplified: 终于，天快黑的时候，路那边，一队人跑了过来，
sentences.traditional: 終於，天快黑的時候，路那邊，一隊人跑了過來，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú tiān kuài hēi de shí hou lù nà biān yí duì rén pǎo le guò lái
sentences.english: Finally, when it was almost dark, a group of people came running over from the other side of the road.

sentences.simplified: 最前面的那个人拿着大刀，穿着红衣，就是太史慈。
sentences.traditional: 最前面的那個人拿著大刀，穿著紅衣，就是太史慈。
sentences.pinyin: zuì qián miàn de nà ge rén ná zhe dà dāo chuān zhe hóng yī jiù shì tài shǐ cí
sentences.english: The man at the very front was holding a large sword and wearing red clothes. It was Taishi Ci.

sentences.simplified: 孙策身边的人大声说：“是太史慈！”大家都很高兴，都说“太史慈回来了”。
sentences.traditional: 孫策身邊的人大聲說：“是太史慈！”大家都很高興，都說“太史慈回來了”。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè shēn biān de rén dà shēng shuō shì tài shǐ cí dà jiā dōu hěn gāo xìng dōu shuō tài shǐ cí huí lái le
sentences.english: Someone next to Sun Ce said loudly, “It’s Taishi Ci!” Everyone was very happy and said, “Taishi Ci is back.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策没有说话，但是也高兴地笑了。
sentences.traditional: 孫策沒有說話，但是也高興地笑了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè méi yǒu shuō huà dàn shì yě gāo xìng de xiào le
sentences.english: Sun Ce did not say anything, but he smiled happily.

sentences.simplified: 从那一天开始，太史慈就是孙策的人了。
sentences.traditional: 從那一天開始，太史慈就是孫策的人了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yì tiān kāi shǐ tài shǐ cí jiù shì sūn cè de rén le
sentences.english: From that day on, Taishi Ci was Sun Ce’s man.

sentences.simplified: 他跟着孙策回了江东，后来一直在江东工作。
sentences.traditional: 他跟著孫策回了江東，後來一直在江東工作。
sentences.pinyin: tā gēn zhe sūn cè huí le jiāng dōng hòu lái yì zhí zài jiāng dōng gōng zuò
sentences.english: He followed Sun Ce back to Jiangdong and had been working in Jiangdong ever since.

sentences.simplified: 他和孙策做了好朋友，还帮了孙策很多忙。
sentences.traditional: 他和孫策做了好朋友，還幫了孫策很多忙。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé sūn cè zuò le hǎo péng you hái bāng le sūn cè hěn duō máng
sentences.english: He and Sun Ce became close friends. He also helped Sun Ce out a lot.

sentences.simplified: 他看孙策越来越厉害，也看到江东越来越好。
sentences.traditional: 他看孫策越來越厲害，也看到江東越來越好。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn sūn cè yuè lái yuè lì hai yě kàn dào jiāng dōng yuè lái yuè hǎo
sentences.english: He saw that Sun Ce was becoming more and more formidable and also saw that Jiangdong was getting better and better.

sentences.simplified: 后来的他和孙策一样，都是江东非常重要的人。
sentences.traditional: 後來的他和孫策一樣，都是江東非常重要的人。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái de tā hé sūn cè yí yàng dōu shì jiāng dōng fēi cháng zhòng yào de rén
sentences.english: Later, he also, like Sun Ce, became a very important person to Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 孙策回到了江东的家。
sentences.traditional: 孫策回到了江東的家。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè huí dào le jiāng dōng de jiā
sentences.english: Sun Ce returned to his home in Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 离开元树的时候，孙策只有三千人。回到家的时候，孙策已经有三万人了。
sentences.traditional: 離開元樹的時候，孫策只有三千人。回到家的時候，孫策已經有三萬人了。
sentences.pinyin: lí kāi yuán shù de shí hou sūn cè zhǐ yǒu sān qiān rén huí dào jiā de shí hou sūn cè yǐ jīng yǒu sān wàn rén le
sentences.english: When he left Yuanshu, Sun Ce only had 3,000 men. By the time he returned home, Sun Ce had 30,000 men.

sentences.simplified: 他带着这三万人，在江东又打了五年。
sentences.traditional: 他帶著這三萬人，在江東又打了五年。
sentences.pinyin: tā dài zhe zhè sān wàn rén zài jiāng dōng yòu dǎ le wǔ nián
sentences.english: He led these 30,000 men and fought in Jiangdong for another five years.

sentences.simplified: 这五年里，那些想做江东主人的人，那些让江东不安静的人，都被孙策打败了。
sentences.traditional: 這五年裡，那些想做江東主人的人，那些讓江東不安靜的人，都被孫策打敗了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè wǔ nián lǐ nà xiē xiǎng zuò jiāng dōng zhǔ rén de rén nà xiē ràng jiāng dōng bù ān jìng de rén dōu bèi sūn cè dǎ bài le
sentences.english: In those five years, those who wanted to become the master of Jiangdong and those who made Jiangdong restless were all defeated by Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 江东慢慢变安静了，再也没有军队打来打去。
sentences.traditional: 江東慢慢變安靜了，再也沒有軍隊打來打去。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng màn man biàn ān jìng le zài yě méi yǒu jūn duì dǎ lái dǎ qù
sentences.english: Jiangdong gradually became peaceful. There were no longer armies fighting back and forth.

sentences.simplified: 现在，江东只有一个主人，那就是孙策。
sentences.traditional: 現在，江東只有一個主人，那就是孫策。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jiāng dōng zhǐ yǒu yí ge zhǔ rén nà jiù shì sūn cè
sentences.english: Now, there was only one master of Jiangdong, and that was Sun Ce.

sentences.simplified: 二十六岁的孙策，把他的名字写进了每个江东人的心里。
sentences.traditional: 二十六歲的孫策，把他的名字寫進了每個江東人的心裡。
sentences.pinyin: èr shí liù suì de sūn cè bǎ tā de míng zi xiě jìn le měi ge jiāng dōng rén de xīn lǐ
sentences.english: The 26-year-old Sun Ce had carved his name in the hearts of every person from Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 江东慢慢变好了，每个人都很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 江東慢慢變好了，每個人都很高興。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng màn man biàn hǎo le měi ge rén dōu hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: Jiangdong slowly got better, and everyone was very happy.

sentences.simplified: 孙策看到大家高兴，他也高兴。
sentences.traditional: 孫策看到大家高興，他也高興。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè kàn dào dà jiā gāo xìng tā yě gāo xìng
sentences.english: When Sun Ce saw that everyone was happy, he was also happy.

sentences.simplified: 但是有时候，想到一些事和人，他还是会难过。
sentences.traditional: 但是有時候，想到一些事和人，他還是會難過。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì yǒu shí hou xiǎng dào yì xiē shì hé rén tā hái shi huì nán guò
sentences.english: But sometimes, thinking of certain things and people would still make him sad.

sentences.simplified: 他知道，他还有很多事没有做，这些事都是爸爸没有做完的。
sentences.traditional: 他知道，他還有很多事沒有做，這些事都是爸爸沒有做完的。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhī dào tā hái yǒu hěn duō shì méi yǒu zuò zhè xiē shì dōu shì bà ba méi yǒu zuò wán de
sentences.english: He knew that he still had a lot of unfinished business, things that his father hadn’t completed.

sentences.simplified: 让他难过的事是荆州，让他难过的人是刘表。
sentences.traditional: 讓他難過的事是荊州，讓他難過的人是劉表。
sentences.pinyin: ràng tā nán guò de shì shì jīng zhōu ràng tā nán guò de rén shì liú biǎo
sentences.english: The thing that made him upset was Jingzhou, and the person that made him upset was Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 他不会忘记，爸爸死在荆州，杀他的人是刘表。
sentences.traditional: 他不會忘記，爸爸死在荊州，殺他的人是劉表。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú huì wàng jì bà ba sǐ zài jīng zhōu shā tā de rén shì liú biǎo
sentences.english: He would never forget that his father died in Jiangzhou and that the person who killed his father was Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 孙策刚回来的那几年，荆州很安静，刘表没有打到江东来。
sentences.traditional: 孫策剛回來的那幾年，荊州很安靜，劉表沒有打到江東來。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè gāng huí lái de nà jǐ nián jīng zhōu hěn ān jìng liú biǎo méi yǒu dǎ dào jiāng dōng lái
sentences.english: In the first few years after Sun Ce returned, Jingzhou was very peaceful. Liu Biao did not come to fight in Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 现在，刘表老了。他是一个老人了，不想打仗了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，劉表老了。他是一個老人了，不想打仗了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài liú biǎo lǎo le tā shì yí ge lǎo rén le bù xiǎng dǎ zhàng le
sentences.english: Liu Biao was now old. He was an old man and did not want to fight.

sentences.simplified: 但是，孙策想打荆州，他一直在准备。
sentences.traditional: 但是，孫策想打荊州，他一直在準備。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì sūn cè xiǎng dǎ jīng zhōu tā yì zhí zài zhǔn bèi
sentences.english: However, Sun Ce wanted to fight Jingzhou, and he had been preparing.

sentences.simplified: 孙策想等江东好一些了，就去打荆州。
sentences.traditional: 孫策想等江東好一些了，就去打荊州。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè xiǎng děng jiāng dōng hǎo yì xiē le jiù qù dǎ jīng zhōu
sentences.english: Sun Ce wanted to wait until Jiangdong was a little stronger and then go and fight Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 他每天都努力工作，在等一个打荆州的机会。
sentences.traditional: 他每天都努力工作，在等一個打荊州的機會。
sentences.pinyin: tā měi tiān dōu nǔ lì gōng zuò zài děng yí ge dǎ jīng zhōu de jī huì
sentences.english: He worked hard every day, waiting for the chance to fight Jingzhou.

sentence_translations: Unfinished Business
Finally, when it was almost dark, a group of people came running over from the other side of the road.
The man at the very front was holding a large sword and wearing red clothes. It was Taishi Ci.
Someone next to Sun Ce said loudly, “It’s Taishi Ci!” Everyone was very happy and said, “Taishi Ci is back.”
Sun Ce did not say anything, but he smiled happily.
From that day on, Taishi Ci was Sun Ce’s man.
He followed Sun Ce back to Jiangdong and had been working in Jiangdong ever since.
He and Sun Ce became close friends. He also helped Sun Ce out a lot.
He saw that Sun Ce was becoming more and more formidable and also saw that Jiangdong was getting better and better.
Later, he also, like Sun Ce, became a very important person to Jiangdong.
Sun Ce returned to his home in Jiangdong.
When he left Yuanshu, Sun Ce only had 3,000 men. By the time he returned home, Sun Ce had 30,000 men.
He led these 30,000 men and fought in Jiangdong for another five years.
In those five years, those who wanted to become the master of Jiangdong and those who made Jiangdong restless were all defeated by Sun Ce.
Jiangdong gradually became peaceful. There were no longer armies fighting back and forth.
Now, there was only one master of Jiangdong, and that was Sun Ce.
The 26-year-old Sun Ce had carved his name in the hearts of every person from Jiangdong.
Jiangdong slowly got better, and everyone was very happy.
When Sun Ce saw that everyone was happy, he was also happy.
But sometimes, thinking of certain things and people would still make him sad.
He knew that he still had a lot of unfinished business, things that his father hadn’t completed.
The thing that made him upset was Jingzhou, and the person that made him upset was Liu Biao.
He would never forget that his father died in Jiangzhou and that the person who killed his father was Liu Biao.
In the first few years after Sun Ce returned, Jingzhou was very peaceful. Liu Biao did not come to fight in Jiangdong.
Liu Biao was now old. He was an old man and did not want to fight.
However, Sun Ce wanted to fight Jingzhou, and he had been preparing.
Sun Ce wanted to wait until Jiangdong was a little stronger and then go and fight Jingzhou.
He worked hard every day, waiting for the chance to fight Jingzhou.
